entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to make a return. The website was so confusing, I'm not even sure if I'm doing this right. I bought some shoes.
I can certainly help you look into that. Just to be sure I'm looking at the right thing, can you confirm the item for me? And what specifically is the issue you're having with them?
They're the cycling shoes. I don't know the model name. They just feel... wrong. The whole process is overwhelming. I'm worried I'm going to get terrible blisters. Can't you just help me?

Of course, that's what I'm here for. I can find your order with your phone number. Just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the shoes, or more of a preference issue with the fit and feel?
I guess a preference? The fit feels tight, and I couldn't figure out the things you attach to the bottom... the cleats? It all seems too complicated and I don't think they're for me.

I completely understand. Getting the right fit for cycling shoes is crucial for comfort and performance. It's no problem at all. I see here you received them just 8 days ago, which puts you unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for apparel and shoes.
Wait, really? So I can return them?
Absolutely. I can start the process for a full refund for you right now. I just need to confirm your email address to send the prepaid return label.
Oh, that's a huge relief! Thank you so much. My email is example@email.com. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

You are very welcome. I've just sent that label to your email. Simply pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you, Isaac, you've been a great help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
Great. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
